definition_zh: 欠款；拖欠；落后（多用于复数 arrears）
definition_en: an amount of money that is overdue and unpaid, or the state of being behind
core_image: 账簿上欠着没付的一栏栏旧账
scene: 月底房东又来敲门，租客翻着攒了三个月的账单。His rent has been in arrears since the spring.
sceneCN: 这里 arrears 是「拖欠、欠款」（第 1 个义项：逾期未付的钱）；句意是他的房租从春天起就一直拖欠着。

pos.zh: 欠款；拖欠的款项（常用复数）
落后；耽搁（in arrears 短语中）

collocations.zh: 事后计酬（先服务后付款）

derivatives.zh: 同源基础词，义为「后方；后部」，arrear 由「在后方」引申为「落后、欠着」
arrear 加 -age，义为「欠款总额；拖欠状态」（法律用语）

senses.title: Overdue unpaid money
senses.definition: money that should have been paid earlier but remains outstanding
senses.definitionCN: 本应早付而仍未支付的款项
senses.example: The company cleared its tax arrears before the audit.
senses.exampleCN: 公司在审计前清缴了欠税。
senses.why: Payments left behind schedule stay behind, like things at the rear.
senses.whyCN: 逾期未付的钱被「落在后头」，如同置于队尾之物。

senses.title: The state of being behind
senses.definition: the condition of lagging behind in duties, payments or progress
senses.definitionCN: 在义务、付款或进度上落后的状态
senses.example: The bridge repairs are in arrears by two months.
senses.exampleCN: 桥梁维修进度已落后两个月。
senses.why: The spatial sense of the rear maps directly onto schedule and duty.
senses.whyCN: 「后方」的空间义直接映射到日程与义务上。

senses.title: Payment after service
senses.definition: payment made at the end of a service period rather than in advance
senses.definitionCN: 在服务期结束时而非提前支付的款项
senses.example: Wages here are paid in arrears, at the month's end.
senses.exampleCN: 这里的工资是月底发放的事后结算。
senses.why: Money that follows the work sits behind it, hence in arrears.
senses.whyCN: 钱跟在活儿后面，故称「在后方」支付。

intro.en: Arrear comes from Old French ariere, behind, from Latin ad retro, to the back.
intro.cn: arrear 源自古法语 ariere（在后），上溯拉丁语 ad retro（向后）。

items.en: Ad (to) plus retro (backward) produced the phrase ad retro.
items.cn: ad（向）加 retro（向后）构成短语 ad retro。

items.en: This blended into ad retro, giving late Latin forms like adretro.
items.cn: 该短语在通俗拉丁语中融合为 adretro 一类形式。

items.en: Old French ariere meant behind, both in space and in duty.
items.cn: 古法语 ariere 义为「在后」，既指空间也指义务上的滞后。

items.en: Arrear entered English in legal and accounting texts as in arrear(s).
items.cn: 14 世纪 arrear 以 in arrear(s) 的形式进入英语法律与账务文本。

items.en: The plural arrears is now the standard form in both legal and daily use.
items.cn: 现代英语中复数 arrears 已是法律与日常用语的通行形式。

note.en: Arrear lives almost only in the phrase in arrears; watch the rear root.
note.cn: arrear 几乎只活在 in arrears 短语里；留意词根 rear。

entries.definitionCN: 后部、后方，arrear 的同源基础词
欠款总额，arrear 的法律派生词
安排，拼写开头相近但义为整理而非欠款
债务，泛指所欠之钱，不含逾期之义

entries.definition: failure to pay or fulfill an obligation
entries.definitionCN: 违约、不履行义务，程度比拖欠更重

entries.definition: not paid or done by the expected time
entries.definitionCN: 逾期的，形容状态而不指金额

normalIntro.en: Picture money left at the rear of the line of payments.
normalIntro.cn: 把钱想象成落在付款队伍最后的欠账。

normal.en: ar + rear = behind, so arrears are payments left behind.
normal.cn: ar + rear ＝「在后」，欠款即「落在后面」的钱。

normal.en: Almost always used as in arrears.
normal.cn: 几乎总以 in arrears 短语出现。

normal.en: In arrears can mean paid after the work is done.
normal.cn: in arrears 也可指事后计酬。

normal.en: Legal noun: arrearage, the total owed.
normal.cn: 法律名词 arrearage：欠款总额。

normal.en: Collocations: tax arrears, rent in arrears.

abstract.en: See a queue of bills with one limp envelope stuck at the back.
abstract.cn: 想象一列账单，末尾粘着一封瘪着的信封。

abstract.en: Feel the calendar pages peeling away over an unpaid sum.
abstract.cn: 感受日历一页页翻过而欠款未动。

abstract.en: Picture a runner trailing far behind the pack.
abstract.cn: 想象一名远远落在队伍末尾的跑者。

examples.en: The tenant fell into arrears after losing her job.
examples.cn: 租客失业后开始拖欠房租。

examples.en: Salaries are paid one month in arrears.
examples.cn: 工资按月度事后结算发放。

examples.en: Interest arrears accumulated on the overdue loan.
examples.cn: 逾期贷款的欠息不断累积。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「额·锐儿」——债主额头上青筋暴起，锐利的目光盯着欠账人，月月催收「额锐儿」的旧账。

root: 拉丁语 ad retro（向后）→ 古法语 ariere（在后）→ 英语 arrear；「落在后头」引申为「拖欠」；同根词 rear（后部）。

sensesIntro.en: From being behind in space, to behind in payment, schedule and wages.
sensesIntro.cn: 由空间上的「落后」延伸到付款、进度与工资的「滞后」。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: an obligation stuck at the back of the line
core.cn: 核心意象：卡在队伍末尾未了的义务

branches.en: the weight of what is owed

intro.en: The prefix ar- (ad-) plus rear keeps the idea of the back of a line.
intro.cn: 前缀 ar-（ad-）加 rear 保留「队尾」的意象。

latinIntro.en: Latin retro (backward) also survives in retrograde and retrospect.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 retro（向后）也留存于 retrograde 与 retrospect。

items.example: at the rear of the bus
